title: Binary codecs: varints, CRC-32, strict UTF-8, and Base64url
statement:
# Binary codec kit (`src/`)

The package contains four ESM modules: unsigned LEB128 and ZigZag varints, incremental CRC-32, strict UTF-8 encoding/decoding, and unpadded Base64url. Preserve the documented APIs and validation behavior. Fix the offset-sensitive varint canonicality check, CRC continuation state, UTF-8 surrogate boundary, and invalid Base64url length handling. These defects are independent but live in one codec package.

bugs.summary: The minimal-encoding check compares the byte index with zero instead of the requested offset, rejecting a canonical zero varint at a nonzero offset.
CRC continuation fails to un-finalize the previous CRC before processing the next chunk.
The three-byte UTF-8 upper-bound check is applied to U+EFxx instead of the surrogate range U+EDxx.
Decoding accepts an impossible encoded length congruent to one modulo four.
